sources.citation: Milano, Pietro. 2025. A sketch grammar of Arguni. Research MA thesis, Utrecht University. 80 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: §3.2 Stress (p. 16) is about Arguni only: 'Stress is lexically determined in Arguni and can fall on any syllable.. Penultimate stress is the most common.' Mbaruan/Bedoanas is named 29 times (pp. 8-9: Mbaruan is the correct language name, Bedoanas the tribe name; data limited to wordlists before 2025; Jacobson Holmström 2025 unpublished Andamata fieldnotes) but nothing on Mbaruan stress.

sources.citation: Jacobson Holmström, Tilda. 2025. A sketch grammar of Mbaruan (Bedoanas). MA thesis, Uppsala University. 92 pp.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: The only grammar sketch of the language (hh.bib listed by Glottolog as a grammar sketch; newer than Glottolog 5.3). A 92-page sketch almost certainly has a phonology chapter with a stress statement; the sister-language sketch (Milano 2025 on Arguni) does. Hammarström holds the PDF (papua/); not in DiVA full text as of 2026-09-17 — ask the author (Uppsala / Mapping Bomberai project, E. Visser) or Hammarström.
